public.text: The master-data list includes client, facility, workforce, product, and terminology registries. Terminology is not master data in exactly the same sense as records of persons, facilities, workers, or products, and the LHR and LIMR are not mentioned.
public.suggestedRevision: Distinguish entity master-data governance from terminology governance, information-model governance, and longitudinal clinical-data stewardship. Identify the appropriate governance responsibility for each asset class.
